purpose: Inspect provenance-bound evidence and append human review decisions to a SHA-256 chained local ledger.
guardrails: evidence must have provenanceRef and SHA-256 source digest
AI citations must resolve to existing non-rejected evidence
AI cannot append decision ledger entries
all decision ledger actors are HUMAN
ledger entries require human notes and SHA-256 entry digests
ledger previousDigestSha256 must match the preceding entry digest
UNKNOWN freshness cannot be accepted for review
canonically rejected evidence cannot be accepted for review
